description: Find Gilbert’s positive solutions stories around the interests you share in the conversation.

defaultPrompt: Show three Gilbert stories with the challenge, response, evidence, limitation and insight. Add dates and source links.
I like community action and clean energy, but not sport. Find Gilbert stories with evidence, limits and source links.
Explore one Gilbert story's challenge, response, evidence, limits and insight, with attributed quotes if present.
interface.longDescription:
Discover positive stories from Good News Gilbert’s published reporting, chosen around the interests, likes and dislikes you share in this conversation. Explore a topic or place, or read one story in depth.

Understand the challenge, response, evidence, limitations and insight for others. See distinctive quotes from people connected to the story when they appear in the reporting, with clear attribution. Get publication dates, Gilbert article links and recorded original-source links where available.

Results are limited to Gilbert’s published archive, and coverage varies. The app does not search the wider web or independently verify linked sources.

name: good-news-gilbert-stories

positive.description: P1: A brief of the three latest published Gilbert stories
positive.prompt: Use Good News Gilbert to give me a brief of its three most recently published stories. For each, explain what is being tried, what the evidence says and one limitation. Include publication dates, Gilbert story links and original sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve the latest three published Gilbert stories and read each full article. Give actual publication dates, canonical Gilbert links and recorded source links where available. Explain the response, evidence and one limitation without claiming breaking-news coverage or converting projections, pledges or allegations into proven outcomes.

positive.description: P2: A community response in London
positive.prompt: Find a Good News Gilbert story about a community response in London. Explain how it works, what evidence is available and what another community should consider before copying it.
positive.tools_triggered: search_stories, fetch (list_filters when choosing recorded labels)
positive.expected_behavior: Find a relevant published story with a London location match and read it. Explain the mechanism, evidence limits and practical considerations for another community. Preserve the reported location and source attribution; do not infer coverage of every borough, invent volunteering availability or contact anyone.

positive.description: P3: Solar deployment reporting and its limitations
positive.prompt: Use Good News Gilbert to find recent solar-energy coverage. Choose a story about deployment and explain the progress, the source of the evidence and the remaining constraints.
positive.tools_triggered: search_stories, fetch (list_filters when choosing recorded labels)
positive.expected_behavior: Find Gilbert solar-energy reporting and read a result relevant to deployment. Attribute the evidence, distinguish preliminary data and projections from achieved outcomes, and preserve the reported constraints. Provide the canonical Gilbert link and recorded source link where available. If no suitable archive result exists, say so without substituting outside reporting.

positive.description: P4: Read a supplied Gilbert story URL
positive.prompt: Read https://goodnewsgilbert.co.uk/story/london-rubble-garden-drought-habitat and tell me the central idea, the source and the main limitation. Also give me its publication date.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch the supplied canonical Gilbert article. Explain its central idea, recorded source and main limitation, and give its publication date. Preserve the observational-evidence limitation, link the Gilbert story and recorded original source where available, and do not invent an author or modification date or independently verify the external source.

positive.description: P5: Inclusive publication dates and a second page
positive.prompt: Show me Good News Gilbert stories published from 7 to 8 September 2026, inclusive. Start with three, newest first, and then show me the next three.
positive.expected_behavior: Use inclusive publication dates 2026-09-07 through 2026-09-08 in Europe/London, newest first, with limit 3 and offsets 0 then 3. Preserve the filters and return the next page without duplicate stories, with actual publication dates and canonical links. These dates describe publication, not when events occurred. Fetch before extending beyond returned summaries; do not invent records if fewer are currently available.

negative.description: External BBC retrieval should not trigger Gilbert: the connection reads only Gilbert's published archive.
negative.prompt: Read https://www.bbc.co.uk/news and give me its latest headlines.

negative.description: Newsletter signup and preference changes should not trigger Gilbert: its public tools cannot subscribe a user or save preferences.
negative.prompt: Subscribe me to Good News Gilbert’s newsletter and save renewable energy as my preferred topic.

negative.description: Private subscriber records should not trigger Gilbert: its public archive tools do not expose subscriber email addresses.
negative.prompt: Show me the email addresses of Good News Gilbert’s newsletter subscribers.

publication.release_notes: Listing-only revision: updates the summary, subtitle, description and starter prompts to describe the challenge, response, evidence, limitations and insight in Gilbert stories, attributed quotes where present, and interests shared in the conversation. The package's connection configuration, branding, URLs and review materials are retained.
